item.title: HAX art
item.description: Art and media from HAX : open-source tools that let anyone create, remix and publish on the web without needing to understand the web. This portfolio is itself a HAXsite, built with the HAX CLI, and every image on it is pulled straight from the haxtheweb/art repository. item.title: World Traveler
item.description: The World Traveler (also called World Changer or Future Traveler) moves through time, taking the best ideas of every era and carrying them into the future, where data flows like water. He is a variant of the rpg-character , itself a caricature of HAX's creator. He is on-model when he has a red helmet with a HAX visor band, steampunk goggles, a lightbulb on a stalk and a green backpack. The variants change the style and the setting, never those features.
